name: action1-mcp-server
description: Drive your Action1 RMM fleet from Claude. 100% Action1 API coverage with safe defaults: every destructive call defaults to a dry-run preview and requires explicit confirmation.
long_description: Hybrid MCP server that wraps the Action1 RMM REST API: 33 hand-curated tools for the common workflows (run PowerShell on Windows, Bash on macOS, deploy updates, reboot endpoints, watch automations to completion) including 6 high-level workflow wrappers (CVE remediation plan, audit log search, software inventory, etc.), plus 133 auto-generated verb-first tools that mirror every operation in the official Action1 OpenAPI spec — 166 tools total. Uses OAuth2 client credentials, automatic token refresh, retry-with-backoff for transient errors (including network resets), and a three-layer destructive guard (env switch + per-call confirm + dry-run-by-default) so the LLM cannot accidentally mutate production state.

action1_base_url.title: Action1 API base URL
action1_base_url.description: Region-specific endpoint, e.g. https://app.eu.action1.com/api/3.0 or https://app.action1.com/api/3.0 (US).

action1_org_id.title: Default organization ID
action1_org_id.description: UUID of the Action1 organization. Each tool can override via org_id.

action1_client_id.title: API client ID
action1_client_id.description: Issued in Action1 console → Settings → API Credentials. Looks like api-key-...@action1.com.

action1_client_secret.title: API client secret
action1_client_secret.description: Shown once when the credential is issued. Store securely.

allow_destructive.title: Allow destructive operations
allow_destructive.description: Set to 'true' to permit destructive tools (run scripts, deploy updates, reboot, uninstall) to actually execute. Even when true, every call still requires per-call confirm:"YES" and dry_run:false. Default 'false' for query-only safety.
